healthCheck.expected: the locked local package starts without network; then feishu is listed and a read-only document/tool probe succeeds
healthCheck.failure: 连接未健康时只显示配置步骤，不声称已经读写飞书

secretHandling.officialCli: The upstream CLI currently accepts App Secret via -s/--app-secret arguments.
secretHandling.risk: Passing a secret as a child-process argument can expose it to local process inspection.
secretHandling.requiredMitigation: The connection wizard must use a private local wrapper/credential broker that reads the secret from Windows Credential Manager or a process-only environment, renders no secret into config.toml/logs/install records, and refuses to enable the server if the locked offline package is absent.
secretHandling.publicTemplateRule: The public template contains placeholders only and remains disabled.

servers.disableRule: Set enabled=false or remove the generated [mcp_servers.feishu] block; do not delete unrelated MCP entries.
